dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: The distance between the bed and the kotatsu is exactly right, and the placement of the wardrobe is eminently sensible... I like this bedroom very much.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: My bedroom is my quiet space. Once I close the door, no one can disturb me...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: ...With the exception of you, of course.
